summary: Capacity management does not see real resource use, so monitor host CPU and memory; cloud and network modules load the execution node more than modules like yum. Lower the instance capacity adjustment if usage is high, and watch disk I/O because controller caches output on disk before saving it.
questions: Why is my execution node CPU high with network modules?
How do I reduce the number of jobs on an overloaded instance?
Why does controller cause so much disk I/O?
